[LINT.8.1] JSON-typed slots delivering an `Interval<Time>` or
`Interval<Date>` use the ISO 8601 interval form: a single string with the start
and end joined by `/`. No other interval has a wire form; a fact carries one as
its two endpoints ([LINT.1.4]).

| Type | JSON form |
|---|---|
| `Interval<Time>` | `"2024-01-15T08:00:00-08:00/2024-01-15T12:00:00-08:00"` |
| `Interval<Date>` | `"2024-01-15/2024-01-22"` |
